title: Polkit pkexec Local Privilege Escalation (PwnKit)
description: A local privilege escalation vulnerability was discovered in Polkit's pkexec command-line tool. The pkexec program is installed setuid root and can be abused by an unprivileged local user to obtain full root privileges.

remediation.title: Upgrade policykit-1 package to patched release
remediation.description: Install vendor security update for policykit-1 / polkit package, or remove SUID bit from pkexec if patching is temporarily unfeasible.
remediation.command_preview: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get --only-upgrade install -y policykit-1
remediation.expected_outcome: policykit-1 upgraded to >= 0.105-31.1; pkexec parameter parsing vulnerability mitigated.

validation_procedure.name: Pkexec Environment Argument Inspection Procedure
validation_procedure.preconditions: Twin environment running isolated Linux lab with pkexec binary present.
validation_procedure.description: Performs safe command-line environment interrogation testing whether pkexec handles argc==0 without reading unauthorized environment parameters.

title: OpenSSH PKCS#11 Provider Arbitrary Library Loading in ssh-agent
description: A condition in ssh-agent allows an attacker with access to the agent socket to load arbitrary shared libraries via PKCS#11 provider paths under certain conditions.

remediation.title: Update openssh-server and openssh-client to 9.3p2 or later
remediation.description: Apply vendor security update to replace ssh-agent with patched library validation checks.
remediation.command_preview: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get --only-upgrade install -y openssh-server openssh-client
remediation.expected_outcome: openssh-server upgraded to patched version; ssh-agent ignores non-whitelisted PKCS#11 shared objects.

validation_procedure.name: SSH Agent PKCS11 Whitelist Configuration Query
validation_procedure.preconditions: Isolated Twin with openssh-server active on port 22.
validation_procedure.description: Queries ssh-agent protocol handshake version and checks if pkcs11 provider library filtering is active.

title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints, allowing remote code execution.

remediation.title: Upgrade Log4j to 2.17.1 or higher and disable JNDI lookup
remediation.description: Replace vulnerable JAR archives with 2.17.1+ or configure -Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true system property.
remediation.expected_outcome: log4j-core upgraded to 2.17.1; JNDI lookups completely disabled by default.

validation_procedure.name: Non-Destructive Local JNDI Lookup Header Diagnostic
validation_procedure.preconditions: Digital Twin running target Java service with loopback logging enabled.
validation_procedure.description: Sends safe diagnostic ping with localized canary format string to isolated twin loopback listener; checks if JndiLookup class is resolved.

title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Denial of Service Vulnerability
description: The HTTP/2 protocol allows a client to request stream cancellation by sending an RST_STREAM frame. When abused in rapid bursts, this induces heavy CPU load on server processing queues.

remediation.title: Enforce keepalive_time, keepalive_requests and limit_req directives in NGINX
remediation.description: Update nginx configuration to restrict maximum concurrent streams and throttle rapid RST_STREAM bursts, or update nginx to 1.25.3+.
remediation.command_preview: sudo sed -i '/http {/a \    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=req_limit_per_ip:10m rate=50r/s;\n    keepalive_requests 1000;' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && sudo nginx -s reload
remediation.expected_outcome: HTTP/2 stream resets throttled to safe rate limits.

validation_procedure.name: HTTP/2 Safe Multiplexing & Reset Diagnostic Check
validation_procedure.preconditions: Twin web service reachable over isolated lab IP on port 443.
validation_procedure.description: Performs single TLS ALPN HTTP/2 negotiation and verifies stream limit headers and server keepalive thresholds without flooding.

title: curl SOCKS5 Heap Buffer Overflow
description: curl contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the SOCKS5 hostname handshake when hostnames longer than 255 bytes are handed to the SOCKS5 proxy protocol handler.

remediation.title: Upgrade libcurl and curl to version 8.4.0 or later
remediation.description: Install vendor patched curl library packages to prevent heap buffer overwrite.
remediation.command_preview: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get --only-upgrade install -y curl libcurl4
remediation.expected_outcome: curl and libcurl4 updated to >= 8.4.0; SOCKS5 hostname bounds checking enforced.

validation_procedure.name: Safe Hostname Parsing Static Library Symbols Verification
validation_procedure.preconditions: Twin terminal available with read access to libcurl.so
validation_procedure.description: Inspects libcurl ELF header symbols and verifies patch commit signature presence in socks5_negotiate function.

title: Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Elevation of Privilege
description: An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists in the Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver (clfs.sys) allowing an attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability to gain SYSTEM privileges.

remediation.title: Apply Microsoft Security Update KB5025239 (clfs.sys patch)
remediation.description: Install April 2023 Cumulative Update or later on the Windows host.
remediation.expected_outcome: clfs.sys driver version incremented to patched release.

validation_procedure.name: Windows CLFS Driver Driver File Version and Patch Audit
validation_procedure.preconditions: Windows Twin VM online with PowerShell management endpoint.
validation_procedure.description: Inspects file metadata of C:\Windows\System32\drivers\clfs.sys and checks QFE patch registry keys without invoking exploit trigger.

title: XZ Utils Embedded Malicious Backdoor in Upstream Release Tarballs
description: Malicious code was discovered in the upstream tarballs of xz-utils starting with version 5.6.0. Through a series of complex M4 macros, the build process extracts a prebuilt object file that intercepts OpenSSH authentication via liblzma.

remediation.title: Downgrade or replace xz-utils with verified safe 5.4.x release
remediation.description: Immediately downgrade xz-utils to known-clean stable release 5.4.5 or 5.4.6.
remediation.expected_outcome: liblzma5 downgraded to clean version; symbol redirection hook eliminated.

validation_procedure.name: liblzma Shared Object Disassembly and Symbol Signature Check
validation_procedure.preconditions: Twin Linux instance with liblzma5 installed.
validation_procedure.description: Scans liblzma.so.5 GOT table and checksums signature against known compromised binary hashes; does not trigger ssh hook.
